Yes - the #StarWarsResistance season finale airs on March 17th.|archivedate=20200529234409}} |creators=[[Dave Filoni]] |writers= |directors= |executive producers=*[[Athena Yvette Portillo]] *[[Justin Ridge]] *[[Brandon Auman]] |production company= |starring= |timeline=[[34 ABY]]{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} establishes that the events of ''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One take place thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to [[34 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. |preceded by= |followed by=[[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season Two]] }} '''''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One''' is the first season of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. It is comprised of twenty-one episodes and premiered on [[October 7]], [[2018]] on [[Disney Channel]], beginning with the two-part episode "[[The Recruit]]." In addition, twelve animated shorts were released in [[December]] during the mid-season break. A [[Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|home video]] release of the season was released on [[August 20]], [[2019]]. ==Official description== ''Poe and BB-8 assign Kaz to the Colossus, where he meets a cast of colorful new aliens, droids and creatures. While undercover to spy on the growing threat of the First Order, Kaz works as a mechanic and lives with Poe's old friend Yeager — a veteran pilot who operates a starship repair shop run by his crew: Tam, Neeku and a battered old astromech called Bucket''. ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|soundcat=Audio files from Star Wars Resistance Season One|imagecat=Images from Star Wars Resistance Season One}} ===Episodes=== {|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}} |- bgcolor="#CCCCCC" !
